notes: supermemory.patch changes 2 source files. React Router 7.18.5, which bun installs from the ^7.5.0 range, stabilized two future flags and rejects their old names: unstable_viteEnvironmentApi is now v8_viteEnvironmentApi, and unstable_splitRouteModules is now v8_splitRouteModules.

app/routes/home.tsx gets a type-only cast, so that the typecheck passes: the loader returns the memory type of supermemory@3, and the prop expects the type of @supermemory/sdk@0.1.0-alpha.8. The build output does not change.

The app has no tests, so its test command in harness/apps.json is the typecheck. The app's own typecheck script runs tsc -b, which writes files next to the sources. The harness runs react-router typegen and tsc --noEmit for both tsconfig files instead.

The upstream repository has no lockfile. The copy installs on its own with bun, so it gets its own bun.lock. pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml come from an earlier install with pnpm. The harness does not use them.
The Worker builds to build/server, not dist/<worker>.
